messages:
Maria P: Quick sync — drafted candidate journey for upcoming design partner cohort. Goal: reduce time-to-first-insight and improve retention through clearer handoffs. Posting a short checklist + proposed metrics. Please react or drop quick notes by EOD.

Sam R: skimmed it — looks good. we should add explicit ask for prioritized product gaps.

Elaine G: +1. also we need incentive tiers and comms templates. I can share 2 email cadences. :email:

Raj E: curious about onboarding seat assignment — do we require dedicated sandbox env? that affects infra.

Maria P: proposal: 2-week pilot, shared sandbox (no dedicated GPUs) for first 10 partners, offer dedicated capacity for tier-2. If infra risk flagged, fallback to recorded sessions.

Amir S: hands-on support: we can provide onboarding 2-hr office hours + runbook. add to ops handoff.

Maria P: recruiting pipeline CSV example:
```csv
company,contact,role,lead_source,status,model_variant,quant_profile,notes
Acme Inc,jane@acme.com,Head of ML,partner-outreach,contacted,redwood-v1,int8,high-fit - wants privacy
Beta Co,raj@beta.co,CTO,conference,screening,redwood-32b,float16,needs dedicated env
```

Sam R: success metrics proposal: engagement (weekly active usage per partner), time-to-first-success (days to first end-to-end run), feedback velocity (# of bugs/asks submitted per week), NPS after 4 weeks. target: WAU>=3, TtFS<=7 days, feedback >=1/week, NPS>=40.

Elaine G: recruitment KPIs: response rate >=15%, conversion to onboarding >=50%, churn at week4 <=30%.

Raj E: note: TtFS impacted by model selection/quantization. we should capture model variant used per partner. added `model_variant` and `quant_profile` columns — good call.

Maria P: added — updated CSV header in doc. next: handoff steps (recruit -> se -> onboarding -> feedback). short checklist in thread:
- Recruit: qualify, schedule intro
- SE: run pre-checklist, allocate config
- Onboarding: office hours + 1st-run support
- Feedback: weekly sync + bug tracker link

Amir S: can we automate pre-checks? a simple Health-check script?

Raj E: yes, will add `health_check.sh` to repo and a one-click invite link for partners. also will capture environment tags.

Maria P: decisions needed: 1) cohort size (10 vs 15) 2) dedicated capacity offer 3) incentive model. please vote :thumbsup: for 10, :heavy_plus_sign: for 15.

Elaine G: :thumbsup: 10

Sam R: :thumbsup: 10

Amir S: :heavy_plus_sign: 15 (prefers more signals)

Raj E: :thumbsup: 10 (ops cost)

Maria P: consensus = 10. I'll finalize and share tracker. Thanks all.

OnboardBot: Created task: "DP cohort onboarding checklist" assigned to @Amir S due 2026-04-05.

Elaine G: will post recruitment cadences in #marketing later today.
